events.text: Goal! Viking 1, Bayern Munich 0. Gianni Stensness (Viking) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Zlatko Tripic with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Viking 2, Bayern Munich 0. Peter Christiansen (Viking) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Erik Botheim following a fast break.
First Half ends, Viking 2, Bayern Munich 0.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Alphonso Davies replaces Nathaniel Brown.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Dayot Upamecano replaces Jonathan Tah.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Ismael Saibari replaces Lennart Karl.
Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is shown the yellow card.
Kristoffer Haugen (Viking) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Viking 2, Bayern Munich 1. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Viking. Jesper Daland replaces Kristoffer Haugen.
Goal! Viking 2, Bayern Munich 2. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) header from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Joshua Kimmich with a cross following a corner.
Jesper Daland (Viking) is shown the yellow card.
Ismael Saibari (Bayern Munich) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Viking 2, Bayern Munich 3. Luis Díaz (Bayern Munich) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Konrad Laimer.
Substitution, Viking. Herman Haugen replaces Henrik Bjørdal.
Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second yellow card to Michael Olise (Bayern Munich).
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Josip Stanisic replaces Luis Díaz.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Hiroki Ito replaces Ismael Saibari.
Substitution, Viking. Simen Kvia-Egeskog replaces Joe Bell.
Substitution, Viking. Viljar Vevatne replaces Henrik Heggheim.
Substitution, Viking. Tobias Moi replaces Erik Botheim.
Goal! Viking 3, Bayern Munich 3. Herman Haugen (Viking) with an attempt from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Zlatko Tripic with a cross.
